notes.title: 🚨Kickstarter + Demo Launch Announcement🚨
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It’s finally here! After working on this game on and off for over three years, the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/302639843/hippoxxus-a-sci-fi-metroidvania][b]Hippoxxus Kickstarter[/b][/url] is now live, and you can play the demo right now! 

This journey started as a small game jam project, and it has grown into something truly special. Your support whether by backing, sharing, or playing the demo means the world and will help bring Hippoxxus to life!

Let me know what you think of the demo! Your feedback is super valuable. Thanks for being part of this adventure!
